decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details submitted including the  brick sample "Hemingford Antique number 7" and "Melbourn" interlocking slates, weathered finish,  grey, sample and  wooden double glazed sash window frame and window latch fixing materials pursuant to condition 2, (sample of materials), of approval, granted on Appeal, ref 1239/H/P36 for the conversion of the Listed Building to provide 8 residential units, demolition of greenhouse and works to boundary wall, together with the erection of 5 two storey dwellings at the rear with associated landscaping and car parking  dated 13 June 2007, received 19 November 2007 be approved.
description: Following approval for conversion of listed building to provide 8 residential units, demolition of greenhouse and works to boundary wall, together with  the erection of 5 two storey dwellings at the rear with associated landscaping and car parking- details submitted pursuant to  Condition 2 (saple of materials) of approved appeal dated 13/06/07
